scope: MetalParts only; source inventory and integrity, no model inference or training
anomaly_mask: single-channel PNG, aligned native dimensions, nonempty foreground
byte_integrity: Hugging Face LFS SHA-256, or Git blob SHA-1 for non-LFS source files; retain local SHA-256 for all
pixel_identity: SHA-256 over native RGB width, height and decoded pixel bytes; no resizing
near_duplicate_screen: Existing fingerprints/screen_pairs: cross-domain dHash64 <= 4 OR pHash63 <= 4 OR RGB32 RMS <= 0.02
near_duplicate_disposition: Candidates only; no automatic duplicate or independence claim
capture_metadata: Only publisher-provided keys can establish physical identity; matching basenames are separately reported as unresolved correspondence hints
stop_conditions: Acquisition exceeds 1 GiB additional download or 3 GiB source storage
Missing, unexpected, malformed, misaligned or hash-mismatched source files
Confirmed cross-development/test byte or pixel identity
Unresolved high-risk cross-development/test correspondence or near-duplicate concerns
preservation: Keep all original files, labels and official source memberships; never remove overlaps to manufacture an independent test
training_eligibility: Only explicitly selected source-train normals could enter a later experiment; source-train anomalies remain present and excluded from unsupervised fitting, validation and calibration
test_exposure: Decode only for inventory, alignment, mask validity, hashes and fixed fingerprints; no visual model-selection, fitted statistics or test predictions
preprocessing_planning: Native 512x512 tiling with 128-pixel overlap and full border coverage is a proposal, independent of test mask statistics; 128x128 full-image reduction is not accepted as tiny-defect preservation
review_budget: No repeated visual-adjudication cycle; unresolved candidates need new acquisition evidence before a confirmatory claim
